correctness.rationale: The rank-one bilinear identity gives B^2=tB; its left and right functional eigenvalues must satisfy alpha+beta=t and lambda^2=t lambda. Exactly the square-zero and complementary-idempotent cases follow over arbitrary fields, including characteristic two. Square-zero matrices of rank r are counted by image/kernel flags and an isomorphism; annihilating functionals have dimension (n-r)^2, with scalar presentation multiplicity q-1. Rank-r idempotents are counted by a Gaussian coefficient times q^{r(n-r)} and each off-diagonal functional space has dimension r(n-r). The independent exhaustive program checked counts 15, 56, and 651 for (n,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,2); proof supplies the unlimited quantifiers and precise boundaries.

originality.rationale: The explicit classification of all operator-rank-one maps on full matrix algebras over arbitrary fields, all-size Gaussian-binomial finite-field enumeration, and dimension-three asymptotic transition are not stated by the inspected primary works. The known complex 2-by-2 classification is acknowledged as prior, not claimed as new. The arbitrary-size AYBE correspondence is a reformulation of the full Rota–Baxter equation and provides no closed rank-one finite-field census. Searches are bounded, so publication priority remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: Original Tang–Zhang–Sun 2014 article full text not accessible; its M_2(C) classification is fully acknowledged and its theorem inspected via explicit 2018 reproduction.

No independent mathematical referee has checked the result.

value.rationale: The first nonzero operator-rank stratum of a standard quadratic identity on full matrix algebras is naturally distinguished, not chosen by a field or arbitrary slice. The all-size exact Gaussian-binomial census and rank-refined structural classification provide an arithmetic/geometric baseline for the much harder higher-rank problem; the dimension-2 to dimension-3 asymptotic change is a nontrivial structural consequence. No broader downstream theorem is assumed.
